messages:
Omar Rahman: quick noon rotation check — posting current state and handoff notes.

Omar Rahman: incidents: 1) batch-worker OOMs in prod-east-1 (started ~04:10 UTC), 2) intermittent 503s from slo-proxy to dedicated GPUs (low volume).

Omar Rahman: mitigations applied: restarted batch-worker fleet (scale down/up to clear leaked mem), enabled auto-requeue for stuck jobs, added a temporary pod memory bump to 8Gi for the hot queue.

Sara Lee: saw the OOM traces — root cause looks like a regression in batching logic that prevents chunking for very long prompt batches. Put a quick revert on the batching change in canary at 04:25 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: revert/batching-chunk-fix -> canary (deployer: Sara Lee) — 04:26 UTC :white_check_mark:

Lucas Chen: slo-proxy 503s correlate with a cooldown timer we added yesterday; rate of 503s is ~0.3% of requests, mostly to model-routed embeddings on eu-west-1. I added a circuit-breaker tweak to loosen the threshold and rolled to 25% of traffic.

Janie Park: monitoring: latency P95 for text-gen steady at 220ms, errors dipped after revert. No customer-facing tickets opened yet. Alerting for batch-worker OOMs suppressed for 30m while restart settles.

Omar Rahman: blockers: need someone to follow up on the batching regression root cause (unit tests caught it but missed long-prompt path). Also prefer overnight owners for the fix and a postmortem if it reoccurs.

Sara Lee: I can own the fix — will add unit/integration tests for long-prompt chunking today, PR target EOD. Will also link the failing sample prompt in the PR.

Lucas Chen: I'll watch slo-proxy metrics and queues for next 2 hours, and revert the circuit change if errors spike >1%.

Janie Park: I'll update status page if we see customer-facing impact. No update needed now.

Omar Rahman: next steps: Sara -> batching fix PR + tests, Lucas -> monitoring and circuit rollback if necessary, Janie -> status page, Omar -> follow up on postmortem template and add example traces.

Omar Rahman: handoff to night shift: @Janie Park will be primary contact after 18:00 UTC, @Lucas Chen secondary. Ping me on slack if anything escalates; I’ll be reachable until 19:30 UTC.

pagerbot: Pager duty alert suppressed for batch-worker-ooms (30m) by Janie Park at 04:40 UTC :pause_button:

Janie Park: noted. leaving a short playbook in the oncall-runbook channel: steps to drain & restart batch-worker, how to grab the long-prompt sample.

Sara Lee: PR link when ready: will paste here.

Lucas Chen: quick check — do we want to extend the memory bump for 24h or revert once PR is merged?

Omar Rahman: leave bump for 4h after PR merge, then revert and monitor. If PR needs more time, escalate memory bump approval to infra-approvers.

Janie Park: acknowledged. no other incidents. handing off. :wave:
